profile.name: Yazan Mohammad
profile.headline: AI Engineer
profile.intro: I'm an AI Engineer in Jordan. I evaluate AI responses and review AI-generated code. I also build web and mobile apps.
profile.about:
I write Python, C#, JavaScript and TypeScript. At MenaDevs, I evaluate AI responses and review AI-generated GitHub changes against tests and repository requirements.

At CAVT, I taught digital skills and basic networking. During my internship at Xocialive, I built React.js features backed by ASP.NET Core and SQL Server and fixed issues across the frontend, API and database.

I studied computer science at Zarqa University. My projects include an Android music player, an Arabic zakat calculator and a real-time chat application.

projects.title: Spitfire Music Player
projects.summary: Built an ad-free Android music player with background playback, a queue, on-device discovery, Jamendo API search and synced lyrics; covered with unit and widget tests.

projects.title: Zakat Calculator
projects.summary: Built an Arabic (RTL) app that calculates four types of zakat, checks nisab against live gold and silver prices from a Next.js API route, and exports PDF reports.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.summary: Built a responsive chat app with authentication, private messaging, input validation, unread indicators and SignalR updates; used Codex and Claude coding agents during development.

bullets: Evaluate AI responses across coding, reasoning, Arabic-language, and instruction-following tasks; assess accuracy and quality and provide structured feedback.
Review AI-generated GitHub changes against tests and repository requirements, identifying bugs and implementation gaps to support code-quality assessment.
Delivered digital-skills and basic networking training, including ICDL, Ethernet crimping, and patch-panel connections.
Built React.js features backed by ASP.NET Core and SQL Server; fixed issues across the frontend, API, and database.
